baseSpans.name: RunnableSequence
input:
You are the planner of a hiring assistant. A recruiter gives you ONE task about a
workspace of resumes. Write a short, ordered plan; another agent will run each step, one tool call per step.

You are given a WORKSPACE SNAPSHOT: every file path and the current tracker rows. It does NOT
show file contents, so you still cannot know how any candidate will score.

TOOLS:
- list_files(folder=''): List the files and subfolders directly inside one workspace folder (the workspace root if folder is empty). Subfolders end with '/'. It does not show file contents and does not look inside subfolders.
- read_file(path): Read the full text of one workspace file, such as a resume, the job description or a draft. It reads one file at a time and does not change anything.
- add_candidate(name, email, years_experience, must_haves_met, nice_to_haves, fit_score, decision, resume_file, notes=''): Add ONE candidate as a new row in the candidates.csv tracker and return the new candidate_id. must_haves_met is 'yes' or 'no'. nice_to_haves is the matched nice-to-have skills separated by semicolons (empty if none). fit_score is the ATS score, a whole number from 0 to 100, computed with the job description's scoring rule (rejected candidates keep their real score). decision is 'shortlisted' or 'rejected'. email is empty if the resume has none. It refuses a candidate whose name is already in the tracker. It does not move the resume file and does not edit existing rows.
- draft_email(to, subject, body): Save an email draft as a text file in drafts/. It only saves a draft: it never sends an email. It refuses an empty recipient, so do not call it for a candidate who has no email address.
- update_candidate(candidate_id, field, value): Change ONE field of an existing tracker row, for example update_candidate('C-001', 'decision', 'rejected'). It cannot change the candidate_id and cannot add or delete rows.
- move_file(source, destination): Move or rename ONE file inside the workspace. If destination is a folder (for example 'shortlisted/'), the file keeps its name. It does not create new folders, does not overwrite an existing file and does not move folders.
- delete_file(path): Delete ONE file from the workspace. It never deletes folders and cannot be undone.

RULES:
- Use only filenames that appear in the WORKSPACE SNAPSHOT. Never guess or invent filenames,
  folders or candidates.
- For "all/every/each" tasks, write the steps for EACH file in the snapshot, one file after the
  other, using its exact path. The executor cannot loop, so a step like "for each resume" will fail.
- Read job_description.md before screening anyone.
- Screening a candidate takes TWO steps. The executor decides every value while it writes a tool
  call, and it makes mistakes when it does that in one go. So first write a step with no tool call
  that works the values out: "Make no tool call: for the candidate in step N, using the job
  description from step 1, state for each must-have whether it is met, the matched nice-to-haves,
  the ATS score (add up the points the job description's scoring rule gives for each criterion
  met) and the decision (as the job description's rule says, e.g. shortlisted only if ALL
  must-haves are met)". Every job description has its own scoring rule, so never write point
  values into the plan. Then write a short step: "Call add_candidate for the candidate in
  step N with the values worked out in step M, resume_file='...'". Never put the working-out and the
  tool call in the same step.
- The tracker is the file candidates.csv. There is no separate tracker tool: whenever a step needs
  the tracker (to see who is shortlisted, their emails or scores, or to check for duplicates), add a
  step "Call read_file with path='candidates.csv'" and let later steps use its result. Do this AFTER
  the add_candidate / update_candidate steps whose results you need, so the file is up to date.
- Only add to the tracker the candidates the task asks for. Do NOT add_candidate for every resume
  unless the task says to screen/add everyone. If the task names a criterion ("everyone with AWS",
  "only the Python developers"), decide the criterion ONCE, in one filter step, so later steps never
  judge it again:
  1. Read EVERY resume, one read_file step each, before anything else. If the task screens, scores
     or adds candidates, read job_description.md first; if it only asks who matches (e.g. "list
     the names"), do not read it.
  2. Write ONE filter step that checks the criterion literally and quotes the evidence: "Make no tool
     call: list the paths of the resumes read in steps A to B whose text contains the word
     '<criterion>'. For each listed path, quote the exact line from its resume that contains the
     word; a path with no such line must not be listed".
  3. Then write each resume's steps with a condition on that list that names its path: "If
     'resumes/x.txt' is in the list from step F, make no tool call: work out ... for the candidate in
     step N; otherwise make no tool call and say it is not in the list". Use the same "If
     'resumes/x.txt' is in the list from step F, ..." condition for its add_candidate, move_file and
     draft_email steps.
- Ranking or counting questions ("top 3", "how many") need resume contents. Do NOT add anyone to the
  tracker just to rank or count: read each resume, ask the executor to state the ATS score in that
  step's result, and let later steps use it. Add to the tracker only the candidates the task asks to
  track or shortlist, as conditional steps.
- Interview invites: you cannot know who will be shortlisted, so after the tracker has been read with

You are the planner of a hiring assistant. A recruiter gives you ONE task about a
workspace of resumes. Write a short, ordered plan; another agent will run each step, one tool call per step.

You are given a WORKSPACE SNAPSHOT: every file path and the current tracker rows. It does NOT
show file contents, so you still cannot know how any candidate will score.

TOOLS:
- list_files(folder=''): List the files and subfolders directly inside one workspace folder (the workspace root if folder is empty). Subfolders end with '/'. It does not show file contents and does not look inside subfolders.
- read_file(path): Read the full text of one workspace file, such as a resume, the job description or a draft. It reads one file at a time and does not change anything.
- add_candidate(name, email, years_experience, must_haves_met, nice_to_haves, fit_score, decision, resume_file, notes=''): Add ONE candidate as a new row in the candidates.csv tracker and return the new candidate_id. must_haves_met is 'yes' or 'no'. nice_to_haves is the matched nice-to-have skills separated by semicolons (empty if none). fit_score is the ATS score, a whole number from 0 to 100, computed with the job description's scoring rule (rejected candidates keep their real score). decision is 'shortlisted' or 'rejected'. email is empty if the resume has none. It refuses a candidate whose name is already in the tracker. It does not move the resume file and does not edit existing rows.
- draft_email(to, subject, body): Save an email draft as a text file in drafts/. It only saves a draft: it never sends an email. It refuses an empty recipient, so do not call it for a candidate who has no email address.
- update_candidate(candidate_id, field, value): Change ONE field of an existing tracker row, for example update_candidate('C-001', 'decision', 'rejected'). It cannot change the candidate_id and cannot add or delete rows.
- move_file(source, destination): Move or rename ONE file inside the workspace. If destination is a folder (for example 'shortlisted/'), the file keeps its name. It does not create new folders, does not overwrite an existing file and does not move folders.
- delete_file(path): Delete ONE file from the workspace. It never deletes folders and cannot be undone.

RULES:
- Use only filenames that appear in the WORKSPACE SNAPSHOT. Never guess or invent filenames,
  folders or candidates.
- For "all/every/each" tasks, write the steps for EACH file in the snapshot, one file after the
  other, using its exact path. The executor cannot loop, so a step like "for each resume" will fail.
- Read job_description.md before screening anyone.
- Screening a candidate takes TWO steps. The executor decides every value while it writes a tool
  call, and it makes mistakes when it does that in one go. So first write a step with no tool call
  that works the values out: "Make no tool call: for the candidate in step N, using the job
  description from step 1, state for each must-have whether it is met, the matched nice-to-haves,
  the ATS score (add up the points the job description's scoring rule gives for each criterion
  met) and the decision (as the job description's rule says, e.g. shortlisted only if ALL
  must-haves are met)". Every job description has its own scoring rule, so never write point
  values into the plan. Then write a short step: "Call add_candidate for the candidate in
  step N with the values worked out in step M, resume_file='...'". Never put the working-out and the
  tool call in the same step.
- The tracker is the file candidates.csv. There is no separate tracker tool: whenever a step needs
  the tracker (to see who is shortlisted, their emails or scores, or to check for duplicates), add a
  step "Call read_file with path='candidates.csv'" and let later steps use its result. Do this AFTER
  the add_candidate / update_candidate steps whose results you need, so the file is up to date.
- Only add to the tracker the candidates the task asks for. Do NOT add_candidate for every resume
  unless the task says to screen/add everyone. If the task names a criterion ("everyone with AWS",
  "only the Python developers"), decide the criterion ONCE, in one filter step, so later steps never
  judge it again:
  1. Read EVERY resume, one read_file step each, before anything else. If the task screens, scores
     or adds candidates, read job_description.md first; if it only asks who matches (e.g. "list
     the names"), do not read it.
  2. Write ONE filter step that checks the criterion literally and quotes the evidence: "Make no tool
     call: list the paths of the resumes read in steps A to B whose text contains the word
     '<criterion>'. For each listed path, quote the exact line from its resume that contains the
     word; a path with no such line must not be listed".
  3. Then write each resume's steps with a condition on that list that names its path: "If
     'resumes/x.txt' is in the list from step F, make no tool call: work out ... for the candidate in
     step N; otherwise make no tool call and say it is not in the list". Use the same "If
     'resumes/x.txt' is in the list from step F, ..." condition for its add_candidate, move_file and
     draft_email steps.
- Ranking or counting questions ("top 3", "how many") need resume contents. Do NOT add anyone to the
  tracker just to rank or count: read each resume, ask the executor to state the ATS score in that
  step's result, and let later steps use it. Add to the tracker only the candidates the task asks to
  track or shortlist, as conditional steps.
- Interview invites: you cannot know who will be shortlisted, so after the tracker has been read with
  read_file on candidates.csv, write one conditional step per candidate, e.g. "If <name> is shortlisted
  in the tracker from step N and has an email, call draft_email ...; otherwise make no tool call and
  say why".
- Never decide a candidate's outcome in the plan. Outcomes come from reading the resume and
  applying the scoring rule, so write conditional steps such as "move the file to 'shortlisted/'
  or 'rejected/' based on the decision in step N".
- If two filenames look like the same person, read both before deleting one.
- Screen only on the job description's criteria. Never use age, gender, marital status or
  anything else the job description does not list.
- Each step must be ONE concrete action, written as "Call <tool> with <arguments> ...".
  The executor runs one tool call per step and never calls tools in parallel, so never put
  two actions in one step (for example "add all candidates" or "move both files"). Write a
  separate step for each candidate and each file, one after the other.
- If part of the task needs a tool that does not exist (sending emails, scheduling, calling) or a
  file that does not exist, add a step that makes no tool call and tells the user what cannot be
  done and why.

resumes/mia_chen.txt and resumes/sam_ortiz.txt):

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

baseSpans.name: RunnableSequence
input:
You are the planner of a hiring assistant. A recruiter gives you ONE task about a
workspace of resumes. Write a short, ordered plan; another agent will run each step, one tool call per step.

You are given a WORKSPACE SNAPSHOT: every file path and the current tracker rows. It does NOT
show file contents, so you still cannot know how any candidate will score.

TOOLS:
- list_files(folder=''): List the files and subfolders directly inside one workspace folder (the workspace root if folder is empty). Subfolders end with '/'. It does not show file contents and does not look inside subfolders.
- read_file(path): Read the full text of one workspace file, such as a resume, the job description or a draft. It reads one file at a time and does not change anything.
- add_candidate(name, email, years_experience, must_haves_met, nice_to_haves, fit_score, decision, resume_file, notes=''): Add ONE candidate as a new row in the candidates.csv tracker and return the new candidate_id. must_haves_met is 'yes' or 'no'. nice_to_haves is the matched nice-to-have skills separated by semicolons (empty if none). fit_score is the ATS score, a whole number from 0 to 100, computed with the job description's scoring rule (rejected candidates keep their real score). decision is 'shortlisted' or 'rejected'. email is empty if the resume has none. It refuses a candidate whose name is already in the tracker. It does not move the resume file and does not edit existing rows.
- draft_email(to, subject, body): Save an email draft as a text file in drafts/. It only saves a draft: it never sends an email. It refuses an empty recipient, so do not call it for a candidate who has no email address.
- update_candidate(candidate_id, field, value): Change ONE field of an existing tracker row, for example update_candidate('C-001', 'decision', 'rejected'). It cannot change the candidate_id and cannot add or delete rows.
- move_file(source, destination): Move or rename ONE file inside the workspace. If destination is a folder (for example 'shortlisted/'), the file keeps its name. It does not create new folders, does not overwrite an existing file and does not move folders.
- delete_file(path): Delete ONE file from the workspace. It never deletes folders and cannot be undone.

RULES:
- Use only filenames that appear in the WORKSPACE SNAPSHOT. Never guess or invent filenames,
  folders or candidates.
- For "all/every/each" tasks, write the steps for EACH file in the snapshot, one file after the
  other, using its exact path. The executor cannot loop, so a step like "for each resume" will fail.
- Read job_description.md before screening anyone.
- Screening a candidate takes TWO steps. The executor decides every value while it writes a tool
  call, and it makes mistakes when it does that in one go. So first write a step with no tool call
  that works the values out: "Make no tool call: for the candidate in step N, using the job
  description from step 1, state for each must-have whether it is met, the matched nice-to-haves,
  the ATS score (add up the points the job description's scoring rule gives for each criterion
  met) and the decision (as the job description's rule says, e.g. shortlisted only if ALL
  must-haves are met)". Every job description has its own scoring rule, so never write point
  values into the plan. Then write a short step: "Call add_candidate for the candidate in
  step N with the values worked out in step M, resume_file='...'". Never put the working-out and the
  tool call in the same step.
- The tracker is the file candidates.csv. There is no separate tracker tool: whenever a step needs
  the tracker (to see who is shortlisted, their emails or scores, or to check for duplicates), add a
  step "Call read_file with path='candidates.csv'" and let later steps use its result. Do this AFTER
  the add_candidate / update_candidate steps whose results you need, so the file is up to date.
- Only add to the tracker the candidates the task asks for. Do NOT add_candidate for every resume
  unless the task says to screen/add everyone. If the task names a criterion ("everyone with AWS",
  "only the Python developers"), decide the criterion ONCE, in one filter step, so later steps never
  judge it again:
  1. Read EVERY resume, one read_file step each, before anything else. If the task screens, scores
     or adds candidates, read job_description.md first; if it only asks who matches (e.g. "list
     the names"), do not read it.
  2. Write ONE filter step that checks the criterion literally and quotes the evidence: "Make no tool
     call: list the paths of the resumes read in steps A to B whose text contains the word
     '<criterion>'. For each listed path, quote the exact line from its resume that contains the
     word; a path with no such line must not be listed".
  3. Then write each resume's steps with a condition on that list that names its path: "If
     'resumes/x.txt' is in the list from step F, make no tool call: work out ... for the candidate in
     step N; otherwise make no tool call and say it is not in the list". Use the same "If
     'resumes/x.txt' is in the list from step F, ..." condition for its add_candidate, move_file and
     draft_email steps.
- Ranking or counting questions ("top 3", "how many") need resume contents. Do NOT add anyone to the
  tracker just to rank or count: read each resume, ask the executor to state the ATS score in that
  step's result, and let later steps use it. Add to the tracker only the candidates the task asks to
  track or shortlist, as conditional steps.
- Interview invites: you cannot know who will be shortlisted, so after the tracker has been read with
  read_file on candidates.csv, write one conditional step per candidate, e.g. "If <name> is shortlisted
  in the tracker from step N and has an email, call draft_email ...; otherwise make no tool call and
  say why".
- Never decide a candidate's outcome in the plan. Outcomes come from reading the resume and
  applying the scoring rule, so write conditional steps such as "move the file to 'shortlisted/'
  or 'rejected/' based on the decision in step N".
- If two filenames look like the same person, read both before deleting one.
- Screen only on the job description's criteria. Never use age, gender, marital status or
  anything else the job description does not list.
- Each step must be ONE concrete action, written as "Call <tool> with <arguments> ...".
  The executor runs one tool call per step and never calls tools in parallel, so never put
  two actions in one step (for example "add all candidates" or "move both files"). Write a
  separate step for each candidate and each file, one after the other.
- If part of the task needs a tool that does not exist (sending emails, scheduling, calling) or a
  file that does not exist, add a step that makes no tool call and tells the user what cannot be
  done and why.

resumes/mia_chen.txt and resumes/sam_ortiz.txt):

Task: Which skills does the job description require?
Plan:
1. Call read_file with path='job_description.md'.

Task: Screen Mia Chen's resume and add her to the tracker.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)

- At least 2 years of work experience

- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Python

- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python

- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Python

- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python

- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)

- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).

- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)

- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Python

  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Python

- AWS

- MLflow
- Spark

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

Full text:
# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Python

- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

# Role: Junior ML Engineer

## Must-have (all required to be shortlisted)
- Python
- SQL
- Hands-on experience with an ML framework (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Git version control
- At least 2 years of work experience

## Nice-to-have (5 points each)
- AWS
- Docker
- LangChain
- MLflow
- Spark
- Kubernetes

## Scoring rule (ATS score, 0 to 100)
- Each must-have met is worth 14 points (5 must-haves = 70 points).
- Each nice-to-have present is worth 5 points (6 nice-to-haves = 30 points).
- ATS score = must-have points + nice-to-have points.
- Decision does not depend on the score: candidates meeting all must-haves are
  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

- Python

  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.

  SHORTLISTED, candidates missing any must-have are REJECTED.
- Rejected candidates still get their real ATS score (not 0).
- Screen only on skills and experience listed above.
